carousels.title: What a Saturn return actually is

slides.head: A Saturn return is not a birthday.
slides.alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: A Saturn return is not a birthday. Small text: Saturn in Aries until 12 Apr 2028.

slides.text: Saturn takes about 29.5 years to go round the Sun. Your return is when it gets back to the degree it held the day you were born.
slides.alt: Text slide: Saturn takes about 29.5 years to go round the Sun. Your return is when it gets back to the degree it held the day you were born.

slides.text: It spends two to four years in that sign while it does it. That's your window.
slides.alt: Text slide with an orbit dial whose gold arc runs from where Saturn enters your sign to where it leaves. Text: It spends two to four years in that sign while it does it. That's your window.

slides.text: Inside the window: one exact pass, or three if Saturn goes backwards over your degree. Those are the dates.
slides.alt: Text slide: Inside the window: one exact pass, or three if Saturn goes backwards over your degree. Those are the dates.

slides.head: Three phases.
slides.alt: Text slide headed Three phases, listing Approach: pressure, no verdict. Contact: the pass. Integration: what you chose becomes structure.

slides.text: It happens around 28–30, again around 58–59, again around 87–88. Same maths, different question each time.
slides.alt: Text slide: It happens around 28 to 30, again around 58 to 59, again around 87 to 88. Same maths, different question each time.

slides.text: Saturn describes the work, not what happens to you. Nothing here predicts an event.
slides.alt: Text slide: Saturn describes the work, not what happens to you. Nothing here predicts an event.

slides.head: Your window and your passes, free, in ten seconds.
slides.alt: Closing slide: Your window and your passes, free, in ten seconds. rite.report

slides.head: Why some people get three Saturn return dates in a year.
slides.alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: Why some people get three Saturn return dates in a year. Small text: Saturn turns direct 11 Dec 2026.

slides.text: Saturn doesn't move in a straight line from our point of view. Each year it stops, backs up for about four and a half months, and stops again.
slides.alt: Text slide: Saturn doesn't move in a straight line from our point of view. Each year it stops, backs up for about four and a half months, and stops again.

slides.head: This year's loop
slides.alt: Text slide headed This year's loop: 27 July 2026, Saturn stops at 14.7 degrees Aries. 11 December 2026, it turns direct at 7.9 degrees Aries.

slides.text: Natal Saturn between 7.9° and 14.7° Aries? It crosses you going forwards (Apr–Jul), backwards (Aug–Dec, now) and forwards again (Dec–Mar).
slides.alt: Text slide: Natal Saturn between 7.9 and 14.7 degrees Aries? It crosses you going forwards (April to July), backwards (August to December, now) and forwards again (December to March). Three passes.

slides.head: First return (28–30)
slides.text: The first adult reckoning. What are you actually responsible for? What did you start that you'll still be doing in three years?
slides.alt: First return, ages 28 to 30: the first adult reckoning. What are you actually responsible for? What did you start that you'll still be doing in three years?

slides.head: Second return (58–59)
slides.text: Nothing left to prove. What structures outlast you? Which obligations did you choose, and which did you inherit?
slides.alt: Second return, ages 58 to 59: nothing left to prove. What structures outlast you? Which obligations did you choose, and which did you inherit?

slides.text: Same sign, same work. Saturn in Aries asks for initiative that holds up over time: starting things you also finish, leadership you can support.
slides.alt: Text slide: Same sign, same work. Saturn in Aries asks for initiative that holds up over time: starting things you also finish, leadership you can support.

carousels.title: What to do in each phase

slides.head: Your Saturn return has three phases. Here's the job in each.
slides.alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: Your Saturn return has three phases. Here's the job in each.

slides.head: Approach
slides.text: Window open, no pass yet. Set the thing up. Decide what you're building and write it down. Don't wait for the pass to make the decision for you.
slides.alt: Approach (window open, no pass yet): set the thing up. Decide what you're building and write it down. Don't wait for the pass to make the decision for you.

slides.head: Approach, concretely
slides.text: One commitment with a daily shape. One agreement you've been avoiding, had out loud.
slides.alt: Approach, concretely: one commitment with a daily shape. One agreement you've been avoiding, had out loud.

slides.head: Contact
slides.text: The pass, or the three passes. Hold. This is where the thing you set up gets tested. The job is to not quit at the first boring stretch.
slides.alt: Contact (the pass, or the three passes): hold. This is where the thing you set up gets tested. The job is to not quit at the first boring stretch.

slides.head: Contact, concretely
slides.text: Keep the promise small and often. The week before each pass, reread what you wrote in approach.
slides.alt: Contact, concretely: keep the promise small and often. The week before each pass, reread what you wrote in approach.

slides.head: Integration
slides.text: After the last pass, until Saturn leaves the sign. Consolidate: what you chose becomes structure. Drop the story about yourself that no longer matches what you did.
slides.alt: Integration (after the last pass, until Saturn leaves the sign): consolidate. What you chose becomes structure. Drop the story about yourself that no longer matches what you did.
